name: Zenta Group Company Limited
summary: Zenta Group Co., Ltd. functions as a holding entity, specializing in the provision of expertise across industrial park development, business investment strategies, and cutting-edge financial technology solutions. Its comprehensive suite of offerings includes administrative support, brokerage services for both investments and projects, and thorough project research. Additionally, the company delivers advanced fintech services, encompassing algorithm-driven solutions and leveraging big data and blockchain technologies. The company was established on March 20, 2023, by co-founders Wai Ian Ng and Weng Seng Sou, and its main office is located in Macau.
